mechanism: margin ranking on the quantized representation (issue #144)
computations: similarity of two items after quantizing to a level: negative squared distance of the cumulative quantized vectors
ranking term: mean of softplus(margin - s_positive + s_negative)
total loss: base RQ-VAE loss + lambda_final * rank(level 3) + lambda_coarse * rank(level 1)
gradient_rules: dL/ds_positive = -sigmoid(margin - s_positive + s_negative), so pulling the edge closer lowers the loss
dL/ds_negative = +sigmoid(margin - s_positive + s_negative), so pushing the non-edge away lowers the loss
s is a squared distance, so its gradient w.r.t. the codeword difference is linear and reaches the encoder through the straight-through path

training_integration.loss: L = L_RQVAE + lambda_final * L_rank(3) + lambda_coarse * L_rank(1)

conventions.distance: squared euclidean on the cumulative quantized vector

excluded.reason: discrete choice of a non-neighbour; cannot be symbolically compared

excluded.surface: argmin code selection and straight-through gradient
excluded.reason: discrete; covered by the four suites and the one-epoch smoke
